<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="27" fill="#143CC9"/>
  <text x="18" y="18" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
  <line x1="326" y1="16" x2="326" y2="11" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="331" y1="16" x2="331" y2="9" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="336" y1="16" x2="336" y2="7" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="348" cy="12" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="346" y1="15" x2="350" y2="15" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="362" y="7" width="20" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="364" y="9" width="14" height="7" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="383" y="10" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Header -->
  <rect x="0" y="27" width="390" height="118" fill="#143CC9"/>
  <circle cx="34" cy="65" r="16" fill="#000000"/>
  <polyline points="39,58 32,65 39,72" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <text x="61" y="69" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="23px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Payment Information</text>
  <text x="22" y="105" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Secure checkout for your movie tickets</text>
  <line x1="22" y1="124" x2="368" y2="124" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.55"/>

  <!-- Order summary card shadow and card -->
  <rect x="20" y="157" width="350" height="76" rx="4" fill="#000000" opacity="0.12"/>
  <rect x="20" y="153" width="350" height="76" rx="4" fill="#E0E0E0" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="34" y="176" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15px" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">THOR: LOVE AND THUNDER</text>
  <text x="34" y="197" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" fill="#747474">Today, Jul 27 · 7:30 PM · Seats E7, E8</text>
  <text x="34" y="216" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12px" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">2 tickets</text>
  <text x="345" y="202" text-anchor="end" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20px" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">$24.00</text>

  <!-- Section heading -->
  <text x="20" y="263" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20px" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Card details</text>
  <text x="20" y="282" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" fill="#747474">Enter your payment information below.</text>

  <!-- Cardholder field -->
  <text x="20" y="311" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Cardholder name</text>
  <rect x="20" y="320" width="350" height="43" rx="4" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="34" y="347" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15px" font-weight="400" fill="#747474">Alex Morgan</text>

  <!-- Card type field -->
  <text x="20" y="389" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Card type</text>
  <rect x="20" y="398" width="350" height="43" rx="4" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="34" y="425" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15px" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Visa</text>
  <polyline points="344,416 350,422 356,416" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- Card number field -->
  <text x="20" y="467" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Card number</text>
  <rect x="20" y="476" width="350" height="43" rx="4" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="34" y="503" font-family="IBM Plex Mono, monospace" font-size="15px" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">••••  ••••  ••••  4826</text>
  <rect x="338" y="490" width="18" height="13" rx="2" fill="#143CC9"/>
  <circle cx="344" cy="496" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.85"/>
  <circle cx="350" cy="496" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.55"/>

  <!-- Expiration and CVC -->
  <text x="20" y="545" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Expiration date</text>
  <text x="207" y="545" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">CVC</text>
  <rect x="20" y="554" width="166" height="43" rx="4" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="34" y="581" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15px" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">08 / 28</text>
  <rect x="207" y="554" width="163" height="43" rx="4" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="221" y="581" font-family="IBM Plex Mono, monospace" font-size="15px" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">•••</text>
  <circle cx="347" cy="575" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#747474" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="347" y="579" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="700" fill="#747474">?</text>

  <!-- Security note -->
  <rect x="20" y="618" width="350" height="40" rx="4" fill="#E0E0E0"/>
  <circle cx="39" cy="638" r="8" fill="#143CC9"/>
  <polyline points="35,638 38,641 44,634" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <text x="55" y="642" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Your payment details are encrypted and secure.</text>

  <!-- Buttons -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="680" width="105" height="43" rx="13" fill="#000000" opacity="0.16"/>
    <rect x="20" y="676" width="105" height="43" rx="13" fill="#E0E0E0" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="72.5" y="703" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15px" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">Cancel</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="137" y="680" width="233" height="43" rx="13" fill="#000000" opacity="0.18"/>
    <rect x="137" y="676" width="233" height="43" rx="13" fill="#000000"/>
    <text x="253.5" y="703" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">SUBMIT ORDER</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="748" width="390" height="96" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="748" x2="390" y2="748" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- Home -->
  <g>
    <polygon points="47,773 58,764 69,773" fill="none" stroke="#747474" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="50" y="772" width="16" height="13" fill="none" stroke="#747474" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="58" y="807" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10px" font-weight="500" fill="#747474">Home</text>
  </g>
  <!-- Movies -->
  <g>
    <rect x="133" y="766" width="24" height="18" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#747474" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="133" y1="772" x2="157" y2="772" stroke="#747474" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="139" y1="766" x2="139" y2="784" stroke="#747474" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="151" y1="766" x2="151" y2="784" stroke="#747474" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="145" y="807" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10px" font-weight="500" fill="#747474">Movies</text>
  </g>
  <!-- Tickets active -->
  <g>
    <rect x="218" y="764" width="25" height="20" rx="3" fill="#143CC9"/>
    <line x1="224" y1="770" x2="237" y2="770" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="224" y1="776" x2="237" y2="776" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="230.5" y="807" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10px" font-weight="700" fill="#143CC9">Tickets</text>
  </g>
  <!-- Profile -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="325" cy="770" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#747474" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="325" cy="783" rx="12" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#747474" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="325" y="807" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10px" font-weight="500" fill="#747474">Profile</text>
  </g>
</svg>
